faq.q: How much does San Diego Law Firm charge?
faq.a: San Diego Law Firm publishes a contingency fee, which means the fee is a share of what the case recovers and there is nothing to pay if it recovers nothing. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does San Diego Law Firm offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. San Diego Law Firm publishes a free initial consultation.

faq.q: Where does San Diego Law Firm have offices?
faq.a: San Diego Law Firm publishes one office, in San Diego. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at San Diego Law Firm?
faq.a: San Diego Law Firm names no attorney on the public pages we could read. That is a gap in what the firm publishes rather than a statement about who works there, and it is why the licensure and discipline checks on this profile have nothing to run against.
